title: Jon Snow and his Favourite Number
titleZh: 琼恩·雪诺与他最喜欢的数字
statementMd:
Jon Snow now has to fight with White Walkers. He has $*n*$ rangers, each of which has his own strength. Also Jon Snow has his favourite number $*x*$. Each ranger can fight with a white walker only if the strength of the white walker equals his strength. He however thinks that his rangers are weak and need to improve. Jon now thinks that if he takes the bitwise XOR of strengths of some of rangers with his favourite number $*x*$, he might get soldiers of high strength. So, he decided to do the following operation $*k*$ times:

1. Arrange all the rangers in a straight line in the order of increasing strengths.
2. Take the bitwise XOR (is written as ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png)) of the strength of each alternate ranger with $*x*$ and update it's strength.

Suppose, Jon has

5

rangers with strengths

[9, 7, 11, 15, 5]

and he performs the operation

1

time with

*x* = 2

. He first arranges them in the order of their strengths,

[5, 7, 9, 11, 15]

. Then he does the following:

1. The strength of first ranger is updated to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b989fec42185029adec488aa738b78d9de953aef.png), i.e. $7$.
2. The strength of second ranger remains the same, i.e. $7$.
3. The strength of third ranger is updated to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3c7c9436158c0744fffbc90f5dcf6769683b82c2.png), i.e. $11$.
4. The strength of fourth ranger remains the same, i.e. $11$.
5. The strength of fifth ranger is updated to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/842bb4d07e058ad06611d99fc15455f0a936cb03.png), i.e. $13$.

The new strengths of the

5

rangers are

[7, 7, 11, 11, 13]

Now, Jon wants to know the maximum and minimum strength of the rangers after performing the above operations $*k*$ times. He wants your help for this task. Can you help him?

## Input

First line consists of three integers $*n*$, $*k*$, $*x*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$, $0 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{5}$, $0 ≤ *x* ≤ 10^{3}$) — number of rangers Jon has, the number of times Jon will carry out the operation and Jon's favourite number respectively.

Second line consists of $*n*$ integers representing the strengths of the rangers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{3}$).

## Output

Output two integers, the maximum and the minimum strength of the rangers after performing the operation $*k*$ times.
statementZhMd:
琼恩·雪诺现在必须与异鬼战斗。他有 $*n*$ 名游骑兵，每个人都有自己的力量值。此外，琼恩·雪诺还有他最喜欢的数字 $*x*$。只有当异鬼的力量值等于游骑兵的力量值时，该游骑兵才能与异鬼战斗。不过，他认为自己的游骑兵太弱了，需要提升实力。琼恩现在认为，如果将一些游骑兵的力量值与他最喜欢的数字 $*x*$ 进行按位异或，或许可以得到高强度的士兵。因此，他决定执行以下操作 $*k*$ 次：

1. 按力量值递增的顺序，将所有游骑兵排成一条直线。
2. 将每隔一名游骑兵的力量值与 $*x*$ 进行按位异或（按位异或表示为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png)，并更新其力量值。

假设琼恩有

5

名游骑兵，他们的力量值为

[9, 7, 11, 15, 5]

并且他使用

1

次操作，且

*x* = 2

。他首先按照力量值排序，得到

[5, 7, 9, 11, 15]

然后进行如下操作：

1. 第一名游骑兵的力量值更新为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b989fec42185029adec488aa738b78d9de953aef.png)，即 $7$。
2. 第二名游骑兵的力量值保持不变，即 $7$。
3. 第三名游骑兵的力量值更新为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3c7c9436158c0744fffbc90f5dcf6769683b82c2.png)，即 $11$。
4. 第四名游骑兵的力量值保持不变，即 $11$。
5. 第五名游骑兵的力量值更新为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/842bb4d07e058ad06611d99fc15455f0a936cb03.png)，即 $13$。

这 $5$ 名游骑兵的新力量值为

[7, 7, 11, 11, 13]

现在，琼恩想知道执行上述操作 $*k*$ 次后，游骑兵的最大和最小力量值。他希望得到你的帮助。你能帮助他吗？

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*k*$ 和 $*x*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$，$0 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{5}$，$0 ≤ *x* ≤ 10^{3}$）——琼恩拥有的游骑兵数量、琼恩执行操作的次数以及琼恩最喜欢的数字。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数，表示游骑兵的力量值 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{3}$）。

## 输出格式

输出执行操作 $*k*$ 次后，游骑兵的最大和最小力量值。
